evals.prompt: Update a canonical custom skill and open a pull request. The user later merges the PR and expects the canonical checkout to be back on main rather than left on the feature branch.
evals.expected_output: Create the feature branch and pull request from a disposable worktree outside the canonical checkout; after merge, verify it, fast-forward the canonical checkout to the default branch, remove the worktree, and report both cleanup results. Do not force-delete a squash-merged local branch if Git does not recognize it as merged.
